name: Move
desc: The engine roars, expelling a plume of Alchemic fire.

stat.effects: The Ship moves Hexes up to its Speed.

name: Ram
desc: Your vessel bears down on a foe, bringing conflict to a swift and deadly end, perhaps for both of you.

stat.effects: The Ship moves up to twice its Speed, and if it Engages another, they collide.

name: Spot
desc: Take-aim and report the precise location of a foe or other feature of the Sea.

stat.effects: Roll 2d6 plus the Tier of the Card spent against the Tier of an unspotted Target. You Spot the Target on a Success.

name: Shoot
desc: The essence of war, the principle of Attack.

stat.effects:
Choose a Weapon, spend Manpower, and roll 2d6 plus its Accuracy against the Target's Tier. Success inflicts the Damage on the Target.
The Cooldown of this Action is tied to the Weapon used, which must be satisfied before any Weapons can be used to Attack again.
Additionally, the same Weapon cannot be Shot more than once in the same Round.

name: Patch it Up
desc: Hasty repairs, barely able to keep its machinery in check.

stat.effects: The Ship's Notch Penalty is removed until Notched again.

name: Evade
desc: The principle of retreat.

stat.effects: All Attacks against the Ship suffer an additional bane this Round.

name: Skiff
desc: A small vessel meant to transport Expeditioners short distances, ill-fit for real voyages.

stat.effects: This is small enough to fit within the hull of any Ship of Size 10 or more.

name: Aether Sloop
desc: The standard Expedition ship, Sloops are surprisingly versatile exploratory vessels.

stat.effects: The standard Expedition ship, Sloops are surprisingly versatile exploratory vessels.

name: Shard Hauler
desc: Meant to transport long-distance cargo in large quantities, the Hauler is the workhorse within the Sea.

stat.effects: Meant to transport long-distance cargo in large quantities, the Hauler is the workhorse within the Sea.

name: Warbird
desc: Built with a prow recalling Verdun sword- hilts, the Warbird is the standard military vessel of Gaetic Arks.

stat.effects: Built with a prow recalling Verdun sword- hilts, the Warbird is the standard military vessel of Gaetic Arks.

name: Sea Falcon
desc: A Reimian design, sharper and more lethal than a Warbird, few Arks boast more than one or two in their whole shipyard.

stat.effects: A Reimian design, sharper and more lethal than a Warbird, few Arks boast more than one or two in their whole shipyard.

name: Telmarine-Class War Galleon
desc: Only a slim few exist in the whole sea, monstrously large and able to demolish nearly any form of resistance in a heartbeat.

stat.effects: Only a slim few exist in the whole sea, monstrously large and able to demolish nearly any form of resistance in a heartbeat.

name: Short Ballista
desc: A small, mounted bolt-thrower.

stat.effects: A Critical Hit with a Ballista inflicts 1 Casualty.

name: Long Ballista
desc: Able to cast bolts at greater range, the Long Ballista is the standard Weapon of most Ships.

stat.effects: A Critical Hit with a Ballista inflicts 1 Casualty.

name: Charge Cannon
desc: Specialized for Ship-to-Ship engagement, Charge Cannons surpass Ballistae in deadly threat, if at the cost of ergonomics.

stat.effects: Critical hits with a Cannon inflict twice as many Notches.

name: Aether Lance
desc: A precise, but damnably unwieldy thing, coiled steel bringing to bear nearly unimaginable force, firing arcs of raw power rather than any mundane bolt.

stat.effects: Critical hits with an Aether Lance inflict thrice as many Notches.

name: Hull-Plating
desc: A lining of hardened steel, meant to be affixed to the hull.

stat.effects: This increases a Ship's Resistence to all Damage by T.

name: Engine-Sharp
desc: Optimized Alembic drive-lines capable of conferring greater acceleration.

stat.effects: This grants a Buff to the Ship's Speed of T.

name: Reinforcements
desc: Underlying the Ship's hull, Reinforcements confer greater resilience to harm suffered.

stat.effects: This confers a Buff to the Ship's Durability, up to 3T.

name: Cross-Sails
desc: An additional set of Aether Sails, able to greatly increase a Ship's maneuverability.

stat.effects: This confers a Buff of T to the Ship's rolled Initiative.

name: Lookout Post
desc: Instruments for spotting and efficient cover-penetration.

stat.effects: This confers a Bonus of T to Spotting Tests, and increases the Range of Spotting by T.

name: Navigatory Instruments
desc: Used to more efficiently find one's way in the Sea.

stat.effects: When Plotting a Course, you may increase your Traversal by T.

name: Aether Wavecaster
desc: An array of tools used to locate Shards and other phenomena within the Sea, sensitive to certain, subtler resonances and ripples in the Aether itself.

stat.effects: This is required to make Forecasts in the Shard Sea.

name: Deckhand
desc: A common sailor, trained well enough to do their part.

stat.effects: A common sailor, trained well enough to do their part.

name: Runner
desc: Trained for quick-action, Runners tend to be younger Verdun on their way to greater positions.

stat.effects: Once per Combat, the Runner can be Played to end the Cooldown of any single Action.

name: Expeditioner Ordinary
desc: Established Expeditioners, Ordinaries are reliable, and capable of greater, if limited feats.

stat.effects: Once per Combat, the Ordinary can triple its Tier for one Round.

name: Gunner
desc: Trained marksmen, Gunners are highly efficient Crew, best able to dispatch dangers in the depths of the Sea.

stat.effects: Each Gunner contributes 1 more Manpower, but only for Shooting Ship Weapons.

name: Expedition-Senior
desc: A veteran Sailor and Expeditioner, capable of nearly any task the Sea demands and more.

stat.effects: Once per Combat, the Senior can triple its Tier for one Round.

name: Expedition Marine
desc: The Ark's finest, and nothing less.

stat.effects: Once per Combat, the Marine can be Played to take any Ship Action regardless of its Manpower or Cooldown.

name: Player Name
desc: Action/Potence:

stat.effects:
Pick two Traits, qualifying with you Skills and Disciplines.
Once per Combat, you may exchange this Trait for another qualified for.
Once per Combat, you may change an Attack to a Critical Success.
Once per Combat, you may prevent a Casualty.
Once per Combat, you may remove a Notch from your Ship.
Once per Combat, you may Move for free.
Once per Combat, you can break all lines-of-sight on your Ship.
Once per Combat, you can change Spot Test to a Critical Success.
Once per Combat, you can increase your Ship's Manpower by thrice the Tier of any one Crew Card for that Round.
You can perceive any supernatural phenomena in your surroundings, unless concealed by an effect with a Tier exceeding your Arcane.
When Patching it Up, you can make an Artifice Test, DC_12+(Ship Tier) to remove one Notch. Critical Success removes 2.
When Rammed, you can increase Ship Hardness by twice your Span.
If you Shoot a Ship Weapon, and its Cooldown is less than or equal to your Cascade, you can Shoot it once more for free, inflicting 10 less Damage.
When Ramming, you can add twice your Crush to the Damage dealt to the Target.)
You can add your Sharpshooting to Damage dealt with Ship Weapons.
When Spotting, you can add half your Scouting.
When Attacking a Ship that has not Spotted yours, add your Skullduggery to the Attack.
Once per Combat, you can perform any Ship Action as a Reaction to anything.
Your Ship's Manpower is increased by your Leadership.
